method: 1080 seeded paired 6v6 main-story battles: five schools, three builds, two gear preparations, six encounters, three seeds, two enemy rulesets. Levels derive from total main-story XP earned before each encounter under the new curve. Baseline only reverses added 5.0 HP/attack scaling; it is not a full 4.3 checkout. No food, training, forging, manual ultimates or boss trials. Fixed legal five-companion roster. Does not prove every encounter or roster balanced.
